# Craft Frame Media

> Craft Frame Media is a video and photography production studio based in Warsaw, Poland and Lisbon, Portugal, working worldwide. Founded in 2021 by Francisco Correia. It produces aftermovies, DJ and artist highlight reels, live multi-cam coverage and same-day edits for electronic music festivals and nightclubs, and event recap films, brand activation content, corporate interviews and campaign videos for corporate and brand clients. Languages: English and Polish.

## Services
- [Festivals & electronic music](https://craft-frame-media.com/festivals/): aftermovies, highlight reels, live multi-cam coverage, same-day edits, social and Reels content
- [Corporate & brand events](https://craft-frame-media.com/corporate/): conference recap films, brand activations, interviews and testimonials, campaign and product videos

## Case studies
- [Upperground Warsaw 2026](https://craft-frame-media.com/festivals/upperground-warsaw-2026/): stadium aftermovie, 20,000 people, Legia Warsaw's stadium, 13 June 2026
- [Affairs Lisbon 2026](https://craft-frame-media.com/festivals/affairs-lisbon-2026/): aftermovie plus three highlight videos edited and posted during the event, 27 June 2026
- [Korolova & Camelphat at Sektor6D, Warsaw](https://craft-frame-media.com/festivals/korolova-camelphat-sektor6d-2026/): Surround's show, multi-cam coverage, live posting and an aftermovie finished in under 24 hours, 17 October 2026
- [Smith & Nephew summer event 2025](https://craft-frame-media.com/corporate/smith-nephew-summer-2025/): corporate event film and photography, Warsaw, 27 August 2025
